course.title: Industrial Management
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: The maintenance department of a large hospital uses about 816 cases of liquid cleaners annually. Ordering costs are \$12, carrying costs are \$4 per case a year. Price schedule indicates that orders of less than 50 cases will cost \$20 per case, 50 to 79 cases will cost \$18 per case, 80 to 99 cases will cost \$17 per case and larger orders will cost \$16 per case. Determine the optimal order quantity and total cost.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
